text: Arpa Industriale, the Italian manufacturer behind the FENIX brand, is part of Broadview Holding ('s-Hertogenbosch, Netherlands). Broadview is controlled by HAL Holding N.V.; all of HAL Holding's shares are held by HAL Trust, whose shares are quoted on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange.
short: Arpa Industriale is part of Broadview Holding, controlled by HAL Holding N.V. (listed via HAL Trust, Amsterdam).

source.name: Arpa for interiors: 'The Group'
source.quote: Arpa Industriale is part of Broadview Holding, a global group of leading brands and materials
